title: Bike Service Log Book Firestore Blueprint
description: Firestore database blueprint schema for Pulsar N160 bike service logs and maintenance tracking

bikes.title: Bike Document
bikes.description: Vehicle details, odometer, and target intervals for a registered motorcycle

odometer.description: Current total odometer reading in kilometers

targets.description: Target kilometers for future service milestones

serviceInterval.description: Periodic service distance interval in kilometers

userId.description: Auth UID of the owner or creator

bikes/{bikeId}/services.title: Service Record
bikes/{bikeId}/services.description: Official maintenance or periodic service log entry

cost.description: Total cost of service in currency units

partsReplaced.description: List of parts or consumables replaced

locked.description: Whether this record is a locked verified entry

bikes/{bikeId}/notes.title: Maintenance Note
bikes/{bikeId}/notes.description: Intermediate garage maintenance logs (chain, wash, tire pressure)

km.description: Optional odometer reading at time of note

category.description: Category (chain, oil, tyre, wash, brake, electrical, general)
